title: LLaVAShield: Safeguarding Multimodal Multi-Turn Dialogues in Vision-Language Models
reasoning: The paper focuses on evaluating and benchmarking safety in multimodal dialogues using a comprehensive risk taxonomy. This taxonomy includes dimensions such as 'Hate & Harassment' (specifically citing religious and social biases), 'Deception & Misinformation', and 'Illegal Activities', which are core components of ethical and moral assessment of model behavior.
